_comment: Web app manifest of MineCards (PWA). Linked by `index.html` (`<link rel="manifest">`); an unknown `_`-prefixed key is ignored by browsers, so the documentation lives here rather than in a separate file, following the convention of `settings/overlay.json`. `start_url`, `scope` and the icon paths are ABSOLUTE because the game is served from a sub-directory of the host (`https://web.jmdev.fr/projets/minecards/`): a relative scope would resolve against the manifest URL, which is correct too but hides where the app is mounted. Consequence: a local server started at the domain root (see `start_server.cmd`) serves the game OUTSIDE this scope, so the browser refuses to install it there and the service worker, whose scope is `/projets/minecards/`, registers without ever controlling the page. Serve the game from `/projets/minecards/` to exercise the real thing.
_sync: The name, short_name, description and icons must stay in sync with the meta tags of `index.html` (title, description, apple-touch-icon) and with `runtime` notes in `sw.js`, which precaches this file.
